newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark says in Ukraine GSM license.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark says in Ukraine GSM license.

text.p: Danish telecoms group Tele Danmark said on Monday that a consortium including Tele Danmark, Deutsche Telekom, Holland's PTT Telecom and Ukrainian state-owned UKR Telecom had won a license to operate a nationwide GSM mobile phone network in Ukraine.

Tele Danmark said that it, Deutsche Telekom and the Netherlands' PTT Telecom each had a 16.33 percent stake with the Ukrainian state holding 51 percent in the consortium, which was named Ukraine Mobile Consortium (UMC).
It said that UMC, which already had established a GSM network in the capital, Kiev, which had yet to go on line, won one of three nationwide GSM licences in Ukraine.
It said the Ukrainian government had announced that the granting of frequencies for the GSM network had been postponed by five months. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33 96 96 52
